review_method: Read-only source inspection; AST-extracted functions and in-memory mocked dependencies. Results summarized from review tool outputs; no real GPU or PyTorch correctness claim.
recommendation: Proceed with unchanged official-example reproduction; independently audit native success labels. No formal framework score.

findings.issue: Independent random parameter initialization without state synchronization
findings.probe: Same mock Model class used for reference and candidate through original main construction flow
findings.limitation: Python random-parameter mock, not real PyTorch GPU test; does not affect stateless Wan RMSNorm task
findings.recommendation: For an independently versioned repair, establish identical initial parameters before comparison.

findings.issue: Report counts loaded functions rather than actual replacements
findings.probe: Original OptimizedModelContext with mocked loader and unsupported flash_attention replacement
findings.recommendation: Report actual module replacements and confirm optimized kernel execution; zero replacements cannot establish integration.

findings.issue: Unknown B300 fallback and non-matching compute ceiling
findings.probe: Mock B300 name, hypothetical SM count 148; compare absent clock with hypothetical 1800000 kHz
findings.limitation: These are mocked device-property responses, not measured B300 specifications.
findings.recommendation: Unknown hardware should expose unknown ceilings; validate device-specific bandwidth and matching instruction pipelines.

findings.issue: Per-kernel budget uses task-global start time
findings.probe: In-memory state with global start 121 minutes ago and second kernel first baseline
findings.recommendation: Track and accumulate actual active time per kernel separately from global budget.

findings.issue: Peak-based stopping input remains None on standard record path
findings.verification: Initialization, CLI schema, record function and all pct_peak references inspected
findings.recommendation: Wire validated benchmark peak metrics into state; retain their precision and memory-level provenance.

findings.issue: Execution failures classified as performance plateau
findings.probe: Five crash records in in-memory state
findings.recommendation: Separate operational failure, performance regression and statistical plateau counters.

findings.issue: Stability FAIL and determinism ERROR do not block overall fast_p success
findings.probe: Original main with correctness PASS, stability FAIL, determinism ERROR and mocked speedup 2
findings.limitation: Auxiliary statuses are separately displayed. Intentional WARN for non-bitwise determinism is not classified as FAIL by this finding.
findings.recommendation: Make overall acceptance status explicit and account for failing required checks before publishing a success label.

capability_observations.probe: Original estimate_roofline_position with rmsnorm, durations 1 and 10000 us, gpu=None
capability_observations.interpretation: Type-based heuristic, not measured bottleneck; does not prevent host LLM from acquiring better evidence.
Explicit hypotheses, single-change iterations, correctness-first keep/revert and >=1% throughput gain are prescribed. Their execution must be assessed from agent traces.
Recorder trusts host-supplied status; it is not an independent correctness controller.
